description: This file implements the FrameInfoHelper class and its implementation, FrameInfoHelperImpl, which manages rendering output buffers and retrieving frame information in a GPU context for Android. It includes classes for handling GPU thread operations, texture ownership, and frame info caching.

classes.name: FrameInfo
classes.description: Struct holding frame size, visible rect, and YCbCr info.

classes.name: FrameInfoHelperImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of FrameInfoHelper that manages GPU buffer rendering and frame info retrieval.

classes.name: OnGpu
classes.description: Handles GPU thread operations for retrieving frame info, including context management and texture handling.

classes.name: FrameInfoHelperHolder
classes.description: RefCounted helper class to safely invoke GPU operations across threads.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a FrameInfoHelper instance.

methods.name: GetFrameInfo
methods.description: Retrieves frame information for a given buffer renderer, possibly involving GPU thread processing.

methods.name: GetFrameInfoImpl
methods.description: Implementation detail that performs the actual frame info extraction on GPU thread.

methods.name: OnFrameInfoReady
methods.description: Callback invoked when frame info has been retrieved.

methods.name: ProcessRequestsQueue
methods.description: Processes queued frame info requests, invoking GPU thread operations as needed.
